newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Wegener buys French record label.
newsitem.headline: Wegener buys French record label.

text.p: Dutch newspaper group and music publisher Wegener NV said on Friday its musical division Arcade had agreed to take over French record label Flarenasch.
Flarenasch is currently owned by French groups Arena, Snmi and Britain's EMAP and will become part of Arcade's French unit Arcade Music Company France.

Wegener said Flarenasch's activities fitted well with those of Arcade, which has been active as distributor for Flarenasch since 1995. The takeover does not only strengthen and expand Arcade's presence in France but also offers opportunities in the Belgian and Swiss markets, the Dutch group added.
Flarenasch was set up in the early 1980s and has a catalogue of more than 1,000 historical recordings, master rights and licence rights.
Among Flarenasch's artists are Michel Fugain, Francoise Hardy, Adamo, Images, Demis Roussos, Nicole Croisille, Jean Pierre Mader, Gerard Berliner and Fabienne Thibault.
At this moment, Flarenasch has a top 10 record in the French charts with the group "Les Chevaliers du Fiel".
No financial details of the takeover were disclosed.
